entries.title: John 10:1
segments: "In solemn truth I tell you that whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the door, but climbs up some other way, that man is a thief and a robber;

entries.title: John 10:2
segments: "but he who comes in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:3
segments: "The porter opens the door for him; the sheep listen to his voice; and he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

entries.title: John 10:4
segments: "When he has brought all his own sheep, he walks before them and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.

entries.title: John 10:5
segments: "But a stranger they will not follow, but flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers."

entries.title: John 10:6
segments: Jesus told them this parable, but they did not understand what he was talking about; so he said to them again:

entries.title: John 10:7
segments: "In solemn truth I tell you that I am the Door of the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:8
segments: "All that came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

entries.title: John 10:9
segments: "I am the Door. Whoever enters by me shall be saved, and he shall go in and come out and find pasture.

entries.title: John 10:10
segments: "The thief never comes except to steal and kill and destroy. I am come that they may have life, and may have it in abundance.

entries.title: John 10:11
segments: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his very life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:12
segments: "The hired servant, since he is not a shepherd and does not own his sheep, leaves the sheep and flees when he sees a wolf coming--and the wolf worries them and scatters them.

entries.title: John 10:13
segments: "He is only a hired servant, and the sheep are no care to him.

entries.title: John 10:14
segments: "I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and my sheep know me;

entries.title: John 10:15
segments: just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I lay down my life for the sheep.

entries.title: John 10:16
segments: "I have other sheep also, which do not belong to this fold. I must bring them too, and they will listen to my voice, and they will become one flock, one shepherd.

entries.title: John 10:17
segments: "The Father loves me for this, because I am laying down my life that I may take it again.

entries.title: John 10:18
segments: "No man is taking it away from me. I am laying it down on my own accord. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father."

entries.title: John 10:19
segments: The Jews were again divided over these words.

entries.title: John 10:20
segments: Many of them kept saying: "He has a demon and is mad! Why do you listen to him?"

entries.title: John 10:21
segments: Others were saying: "These are not the words of one demon-possessed. Can a demoniac open the eyes of the blind?"

entries.title: John 10:22
segments: Then came the feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

entries.title: John 10:23
segments: It was winter, and Jesus used to walk in the Temple, in Solomon's Portico.

entries.title: John 10:24
segments: Then all the Jews encircled him and kept asking him: "How long are you going to keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."

entries.title: John 10:25
segments: Jesus answered them: "I have told you, and you do not believe. The works which I am doing in my Father's name, these bear witness concerning me.

entries.title: John 10:26
segments: "But you do not believe, because you are not of my sheep.

entries.title: John 10:27
segments: "My sheep listen to my voice, and I know them and they follow me.

entries.title: John 10:28
segments: "I am giving them eternal life, and they shall never perish, nor shall any one snatch them out of my hand.

entries.title: John 10:29
segments: "My Father who has given them to me is stronger than all, and no one can snatch them out of my Father's hand.

entries.title: John 10:30
segments: "I and my Father are one."

entries.title: John 10:31
segments: The Jews again took stones with which to stone him. Jesus said to them:

entries.title: John 10:32
segments: "I have shown you many good deeds from my Father. For which of these are you going to stone me?"

entries.title: John 10:33
segments: "We are not going to stone you for a good deed," answered the Jews, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, are making yourself God."

entries.title: John 10:34
segments: "Is it written in your law," replied Jesus, "I said, You are gods?

entries.title: John 10:35
segments: "If those to whom the word of God came are called gods (and the Scripture cannot be annulled),

entries.title: John 10:36
segments: do you mean to tell me, whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world, `You are blaspheming,' because I said, `I am the Son of God'?

entries.title: John 10:37
segments: "If I am not doing the deeds of my Father, do not believe me.

entries.title: John 10:38
segments: "But if I am doing them, then though you believe not me, believe the deeds, in order that you may come to know and keep on clearly understanding that the Father is in me and I am in the Father."

entries.title: John 10:39
segments: Then again they attempted to seize him, but he escaped out of their hands,

entries.title: John 10:40
segments: and went away again across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing at first, and there he remained.

entries.title: John 10:41
segments: Many who came to him said, "John did not perform any signs, but everything he said about this man was true."

entries.title: John 10:42
segments: And many believed on him there.
